items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Applications / Database

*   [kividbio/kividb (⭐949)](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb) - Redis-compatible in-memory database with built-in full-text and vector search [![CI](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Productivity

*   [Skykeep (⭐129)](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep) - iCloud Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Contacts, Drive and Photos as desktop apps for Linux and Windows, kept in a local library that works offline [![CI](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Network programming

*   NetworkManager
    *   [freedesktop-rs/nmrs (⭐327)](https://github.com/freedesktop-rs/nmrs) \[[nmrs](https://crates.io/crates/nmrs)] - NetworkManager bindings over D-Bus: Wi-Fi, VPN, saved profiles, secret agent, monitoring. [![CI](https://github.com/freedesktop-rs/nmrs/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/freedesktop-rs/nmrs/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

items.title: ALL About RSS
items.content_text:
